paragraphs.cn: “再见，非常谢谢你们！”女孩回答。猴子们飞上了天空，一眨眼就不见了。

paragraphs.en: The country of the Quadlings seemed rich and happy.
paragraphs.cn: 奎德林人的国家看起来很富有，大家都很开心。

paragraphs.en: There was field upon field of ripening grain, with well-paved roads running between, and pretty rippling brooks with strong bridges across them.
paragraphs.cn: 这里有好多成熟的庄稼地，中间是修得很好的路，还有哗哗流淌的小河，上面架着结实的桥。

paragraphs.en: The fences and houses and bridges were all painted bright red, just as they had been painted yellow in the country of the Winkies and blue in the country of the Munchkins.
paragraphs.cn: 这里的篱笆、房子和桥，都漆成了鲜红色，就像在温基人的国家是黄色的，在芒奇金人的国家是蓝色的那样。

paragraphs.en: The Quadlings themselves, who were short and fat and looked chubby and good-natured, were dressed all in red, which showed bright against the green grass and the yellowing grain.
paragraphs.cn: 奎德林人们自己，又矮又胖，看起来很可爱很和善。他们都穿着红色的衣服，在绿草和金黄的庄稼地里显得特别亮眼。

paragraphs.en: The Monkeys had set them down near a farmhouse, and the four travelers walked up to it and knocked at the door.
paragraphs.cn: 猴子们把他们放在一个农舍旁边，四个旅行者走过去敲了敲门。

paragraphs.en: It was opened by the farmer’s wife, and when Dorothy asked for something to eat the woman gave them all a good dinner, with three kinds of cake and four kinds of cookies, and a bowl of milk for Toto.
paragraphs.cn: 农夫的妻子开了门，当多萝西问有没有东西吃时，那位婶婶给他们准备了一顿好吃的晚餐，有三种蛋糕和四种饼干，还给了托托一碗牛奶。

paragraphs.en: “How far is it to the Castle of Glinda?” asked the child.
paragraphs.cn: “离格林达的城堡还有多远呀？”孩子问。

paragraphs.en: “It is not a great way,” answered the farmer’s wife.
paragraphs.cn: “不远了。”农夫的妻子回答。

paragraphs.en: “Take the road to the South and you will soon reach it.”
paragraphs.cn: “沿着南边的路走，很快就能到。”

paragraphs.en: Thanking the good woman, they started afresh and walked by the fields and across the pretty bridges until they saw before them a very beautiful Castle.
paragraphs.cn: 谢谢好心的婶婶，他们又往前走，路过田地，走过漂亮的小桥，最后看到一座很美的城堡。

paragraphs.en: Before the gates were three young girls, dressed in handsome red uniforms trimmed with gold braid; and as Dorothy approached, one of them said to her:
paragraphs.cn: 城堡大门前有三个小姑娘，她们穿着漂亮的红色制服，上面有金色的花边。当多萝西走过来的时候，其中一个对她说：

paragraphs.en: “Why have you come to the South Country?”
paragraphs.cn: “你们为什么来南边的国家？”

paragraphs.en: “To see the Good Witch who rules here,” she answered.
paragraphs.cn: “来看这里做主的好女巫。” 她回答。

paragraphs.en: “Will you take me to her?”
paragraphs.cn: “你能带我去找她吗？”

paragraphs.en: “Let me have your name, and I will ask Glinda if she will receive you.”
paragraphs.cn: “告诉我你的名字，我去问问格林达，看她愿不愿意见你们。”

paragraphs.en: They told who they were, and the girl soldier went into the Castle.
paragraphs.cn: 他们说了自己是谁，那个小士兵就走进城堡里了。

paragraphs.en: After a few moments she came back to say that Dorothy and the others were to be admitted at once.
paragraphs.cn: 没过一会儿她就回来了，说多萝西他们可以马上进去。

chapters.title_en: Glinda The Good Witch Grants Dorothy’s Wish
chapters.title_zh: 好女巫格林达实现了多萝西的愿望

paragraphs.en: Before they went to see Glinda, however, they were taken to a room of the Castle, where Dorothy washed her face and combed her hair, and the Lion shook the dust out of his mane, and the Scarecrow patted himself into his best shape, and the Woodman polished his tin and oiled his joints.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，在他们去见格林达之前，他们被带到城堡的一个房间。多萝西洗了脸，梳了头发；狮子抖掉它毛上的灰尘；稻草人把自己拍得美美的；铁皮人擦亮了身体，给关节涂了油。

paragraphs.en: When they were all quite presentable they followed the soldier girl into a big room where the Witch Glinda sat upon a throne of rubies.
paragraphs.cn: 他们都收拾好后，跟着小士兵来到一个大房间。巫师格林达正坐在一把红宝石做的椅子上。

paragraphs.en: She was both beautiful and young to their eyes.
paragraphs.cn: 在他们看来，她又漂亮又年轻。

paragraphs.en: Her hair was a rich red in color and fell in flowing ringlets over her shoulders.
paragraphs.cn: 她的头发是很好看的红色，卷卷地披在肩膀上。

paragraphs.en: Her dress was pure white but her eyes were blue, and they looked kindly upon the little girl.
paragraphs.cn: 她的裙子是白色的，但眼睛是蓝色的。她很亲切地看着小姑娘。

paragraphs.en: “What can I do for you, my child?” she asked.
paragraphs.cn: “孩子，我能帮你什么呢？” 她问。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy told the Witch all her story: how the cyclone had brought her to the Land of Oz, how she had found her companions, and of the wonderful adventures they had met with.
paragraphs.cn: 多萝西把她的故事都告诉了巫师：龙卷风怎么把她带到奥兹国，她怎么找到朋友们，还有他们遇到的那些很棒的冒险。

paragraphs.en: “My greatest wish now,” she added, “is to get back to Kansas, for Aunt Em will surely think something dreadful has happened to me, and that will make her put on mourning; and unless the crops are better this year than they were last, I am sure Uncle Henry cannot afford it.”
paragraphs.cn: “我现在最想的，”她又说，“就是回到堪萨斯身边。因为艾姆婶婶一定会觉得我出了什么可怕的事，她会很难过的。如果今年收成不比去年好，我想亨利叔叔肯定也没钱。”

paragraphs.en: Glinda leaned forward and kissed the sweet, upturned face of the loving little girl.
paragraphs.cn: 格林达弯下腰，亲了亲这个可爱小姑娘甜甜的脸。

paragraphs.en: “Bless your dear heart,” she said, “I am sure I can tell you of a way to get back to Kansas.”
paragraphs.cn: “好孩子，”她说，“我肯定能告诉你一个办法，让你回到堪萨斯身边。”

paragraphs.en: Then she added, “But, if I do, you must give me the Golden Cap.”
paragraphs.cn: 然后她又说，“但是，如果我帮你，你必须把金冠给我。”

paragraphs.en: “Willingly!” exclaimed Dorothy; “indeed, it is of no use to me now, and when you have it you can command the Winged Monkeys three times.”
paragraphs.cn: “没问题！”多萝西大声说，“它现在对我没什么用了。你有了它，就可以让飞猴帮你三次。”

paragraphs.en: “And I think I shall need their service just those three times,” answered Glinda, smiling.
paragraphs.cn: “我想我正好需要它们帮我三次。”格林达笑着说。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy then gave her the Golden Cap, and the Witch said to the Scarecrow, “What will you do when Dorothy has left us?”
paragraphs.cn: 多萝西把金冠给了她，巫师对稻草人说，“当多萝西离开我们后，你准备做什么？”

paragraphs.en: “I will return to the Emerald City,” he replied, “for Oz has made me its ruler and the people like me.
paragraphs.cn: “我要回到翡翠城去，”他回答，“因为奥兹大王让我做了那里的王，人们也都很喜欢我。

paragraphs.en: The only thing that worries me is how to cross the hill of the Hammer-Heads.”
paragraphs.cn: 唯一让我担心的是，怎么穿过锤头人的山。”

paragraphs.en: “By means of the Golden Cap I shall command the Winged Monkeys to carry you to the gates of the Emerald City,” said Glinda, “for it would be a shame to deprive the people of so wonderful a ruler.”
paragraphs.cn: “我会用金冠让飞猴把你送到翡翠城的城门，”格林达说，“因为让大家失去你这样棒的王，太可惜了。”

paragraphs.en: “Am I really wonderful?” asked the Scarecrow.
paragraphs.cn: “我真的那么棒吗？”稻草人问。

paragraphs.en: “You are unusual,” replied Glinda.
paragraphs.cn: “你很特别。”格林达说。

paragraphs.en: Turning to the Tin Woodman, she asked, “What will become of you when Dorothy leaves this country?”
paragraphs.cn: 她转头对铁皮人说，“当多萝西离开这里的时候，你准备做什么？”

paragraphs.en: He leaned on his axe and thought a moment.
paragraphs.cn: 他靠着斧头，想了一会儿。

paragraphs.en: Then he said, “The Winkies were very kind to me, and wanted me to rule over them after the Wicked Witch died.
paragraphs.cn: 然后他说，“温基人对我很好，他们希望我在坏女巫去世后，去当他们的王。”

paragraphs.en: I am fond of the Winkies, and if I could get back again to the Country of the West, I should like nothing better than to rule over them forever.”
paragraphs.cn: 我喜欢那些温基人。如果我能回到西方国度，我最想做的就是永远统治它们。

paragraphs.en: “My second command to the Winged Monkeys,” said Glinda “will be that they carry you safely to the land of the Winkies.
paragraphs.cn: “我对飞猴的第二个命令是，”格林达说，“让它们把你安全地送到温基人的土地。

paragraphs.en: Your brain may not be so large to look at as those of the Scarecrow, but you are really brighter than he is—when you are well polished—and I am sure you will rule the Winkies wisely and well.”
paragraphs.cn: 你的脑袋可能没有稻草人的看起来那么大，但你其实比他聪明多了——只要你擦亮一点。我肯定你会好好地、聪明地管理温基人的。”

paragraphs.en: Then the Witch looked at the big, shaggy Lion and asked, “When Dorothy has returned to her own home, what will become of you?”
paragraphs.cn: 接着，女巫看着那只又大又毛茸茸的狮子，问道：“等多萝西回了家，你怎么办呢？”

paragraphs.en: “Over the hill of the Hammer-Heads,” he answered, “lies a grand old forest, and all the beasts that live there have made me their King.
paragraphs.cn: “翻过锤头人的山，”他回答，“有一片很大的老森林，那里的所有动物都让我做了它们的国王。

paragraphs.en: If I could only get back to this forest, I would pass my life very happily there.”
paragraphs.cn: 如果我能回到那片森林，我会在那里过得非常开心。”

paragraphs.en: “My third command to the Winged Monkeys,” said Glinda, “shall be to carry you to your forest.
paragraphs.cn: “我对飞猴的第三个命令，”格林达说，“是把你们送到你们的森林里。

paragraphs.en: Then, having used up the powers of the Golden Cap, I shall give it to the King of the Monkeys, that he and his band may thereafter be free for evermore.”
paragraphs.cn: 然后，等金冠的力量用完了，我就把它送给猴子国王，这样他和他的猴子们就可以永远自由了。”

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow and the Tin Woodman and the Lion now thanked the Good Witch earnestly for her kindness; and Dorothy exclaimed:
paragraphs.cn: 稻草人、铁皮人和狮子现在真诚地感谢好女巫的好心；多萝西大声说：

paragraphs.en: “You are certainly as good as you are beautiful!
paragraphs.cn: “你真是人美心善啊！

paragraphs.en: But you have not yet told me how to get back to Kansas.”
paragraphs.cn: 但你还没告诉我怎么回堪萨斯呢。”

paragraphs.en: “Your Silver Shoes will carry you over the desert,” replied Glinda.
paragraphs.cn: “你的银鞋会带你穿过沙漠的，”格林达回答。

paragraphs.en: “If you had known their power you could have gone back to your Aunt Em the very first day you came to this country.”
paragraphs.cn: “如果你知道它们有多厉害，你第一天来到这里就能回艾姆婶婶了。”

paragraphs.en: “But then I should not have had my wonderful brains!” cried the Scarecrow. “I might have passed my whole life in the farmer’s cornfield.”
paragraphs.cn: “但那样我就没有我这聪明的脑袋了！”稻草人大叫道。“我可能会在农民的玉米地里过一辈子。”

paragraphs.en: “And I should not have had my lovely heart,” said the Tin Woodman.
paragraphs.cn: “我也就不会有我这颗善良的心了，”铁皮人说。

paragraphs.en: “I might have stood and rusted in the forest till the end of the world.”
paragraphs.cn: “我可能就会在森林里站着，一直生锈，直到世界末日。”

paragraphs.en: “And I should have lived a coward forever,” declared the Lion, “and no beast in all the forest would have had a good word to say to me.”
paragraphs.cn: “我也会永远是个胆小鬼，”狮子说，“森林里没有一个动物会说我好话。”

paragraphs.en: “This is all true,” said Dorothy, “and I am glad I was of use to these good friends.
paragraphs.cn: “这些都是真的，”多萝西说，“我很高兴能帮到这些好朋友。

paragraphs.en: But now that each of them has had what he most desired, and each is happy in having a kingdom to rule besides, I think I should like to go back to Kansas.”
paragraphs.cn: 但现在他们都得到了自己最想要的东西，每个人都有自己的王国可以管理，我也想回堪萨斯了。”

paragraphs.en: “The Silver Shoes,” said the Good Witch, “have wonderful powers.
paragraphs.cn: “银鞋，”好女巫说，“有神奇的力量。

paragraphs.en: And one of the most curious things about them is that they can carry you to any place in the world in three steps, and each step will be made in the wink of an eye.
paragraphs.cn: 它们最特别的一点是，它们可以三步就把你带到世界上的任何地方，每一步都快得像眨眼一样。

paragraphs.en: All you have to do is to knock the heels together three times and command the shoes to carry you wherever you wish to go.”
paragraphs.cn: 你只要把鞋跟敲三下，然后命令鞋子带你去你想去的地方就行了。”

paragraphs.en: “If that is so,” said the child joyfully, “I will ask them to carry me back to Kansas at once.”
paragraphs.cn: “如果真是这样，”孩子高兴地说，“我这就让它们带我回堪萨斯。”

paragraphs.en: She threw her arms around the Lion’s neck and kissed him, patting his big head tenderly.
paragraphs.cn: 她抱住狮子的脖子亲了他一下，温柔地拍了拍他的大脑袋。

paragraphs.en: Then she kissed the Tin Woodman, who was weeping in a way most dangerous to his joints.
paragraphs.cn: 然后她亲了亲铁皮人，它正哭得关节都快散架了。

paragraphs.en: But she hugged the soft, stuffed body of the Scarecrow in her arms instead of kissing his painted face, and found she was crying herself at this sorrowful parting from her loving comrades.
paragraphs.cn: 但她没有亲稻草人画出来的脸，而是抱住了它软软的身体。她发现自己也哭了，因为要和这些亲爱的朋友们难过地分开了。

paragraphs.en: Glinda the Good stepped down from her ruby throne to give the little girl a good-bye kiss, and Dorothy thanked her for all the kindness she had shown to her friends and herself.
paragraphs.cn: 善良的格林达从她的红宝石宝座上走下来，给小女孩一个再见吻，多萝西感谢她对自己和朋友们的所有好意。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy now took Toto up solemnly in her arms, and having said one last good-bye she clapped the heels of her shoes together three times, saying:
paragraphs.cn: 多萝西庄重地抱起托托，说了最后一声再见后，她把鞋跟敲了三下，说：

paragraphs.en: “Take me home to Aunt Em!”
paragraphs.cn: “带我回艾姆婶婶！”

paragraphs.en: Instantly she was whirling through the air, so swiftly that all she could see or feel was the wind whistling past her ears.
paragraphs.cn: 瞬间，她就在空中飞速旋转，快得她只能看到和感觉到风从耳边呼啸而过。

paragraphs.en: The Silver Shoes took but three steps, and then she stopped so suddenly that she rolled over upon the grass several times before she knew where she was.
paragraphs.cn: 银鞋只走了三步，就突然停住了。她还在草地上滚了好几圈，才明白自己在哪里。

paragraphs.en: At length, however, she sat up and looked about her.
paragraphs.cn: 终于，她坐起来，看了看周围。

paragraphs.en: “Good gracious!” she cried.
paragraphs.cn: “哎呀！”她大叫一声。

paragraphs.en: For she was sitting on the broad Kansas prairie, and just before her was the new farmhouse Uncle Henry built after the cyclone had carried away the old one.
paragraphs.cn: 因为她正坐在宽阔的堪萨斯大草原上。她面前是一座新农舍亨利叔叔，这是龙卷风把老房子吹走后盖的。

paragraphs.en: Uncle Henry was milking the cows in the barnyard, and Toto had jumped out of her arms and was running toward the barn, barking furiously.
paragraphs.cn: 亨利叔叔正在牛圈里挤牛奶。托托从她怀里跳出来，对着牛圈汪汪叫着跑过去。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy stood up and found she was in her stocking-feet.
paragraphs.cn: 多萝西站起来，发现自己只穿着袜子。

paragraphs.en: For the Silver Shoes had fallen off in her flight through the air, and were lost forever in the desert.
paragraphs.cn: 因为银鞋在空中飞的时候掉了，永远地丢在沙漠里了。

paragraphs.en: Aunt Em had just come out of the house to water the cabbages when she looked up and saw Dorothy running toward her.
paragraphs.cn: 艾姆婶婶刚从屋子里出来给白菜浇水。她一抬头，就看见多萝西朝她跑过来。

paragraphs.en: “My darling child!” she cried, folding the little girl in her arms and covering her face with kisses. “Where in the world did you come from?”
paragraphs.cn: “我的宝贝！”她大声说，抱住小女孩，亲着她的脸。“你到底是从哪里来的呀？”

paragraphs.en: “From the Land of Oz,” said Dorothy gravely.
paragraphs.cn: “从奥兹国来的。”多萝西认真地说。

paragraphs.en: “And here is Toto, too.
paragraphs.cn: “还有托托也在这里呢。

paragraphs.en: And oh, Aunt Em!
paragraphs.cn: “哦，艾姆婶婶！

paragraphs.en: I’m so glad to be at home again!”
paragraphs.cn: 我又回到家了，真开心！”
